main_measure.name: pooled slope of coin-excess 5-bar forward return on forecast, grid bars with forecast > 0

statistic.name: slope t, errors clustered by date

main_measure.threshold: slope > 0 with t >= 2 confirms (with mean excess > 0); slope < 0 with t <= -2 rejects

supporting_check.name: mean excess 5-bar return on the same grid bars > 0

decided_by: The slope is positive with t >= 2 and the mean excess 5-bar return is above 0 (confirm rule).
reading: The situation is a rise day (raw rise_vol_units > 0, or the 1-day close return when not recorded) on a bar of the choppy-calm profile (regime 'unknown', the only non-vetoed regime), long side; the coin's mean 5-bar return is the mean of its non-overlapping grid 5-bar returns over all windows; the regression has an intercept and cluster-robust (by UTC date) errors with the usual small-sample correction; the plan's minimum of 40 grid bars over 20 dates, if not reached, gives 'not observable'.

direction_check.why: main measure +0.001239 on the check folds against +0.002585 on every fold
